subject: jarl-yrsa
q: BELIEVED GONE WITH THE FERTILITY, AND NOBODY HAS TRIED IN A THOUSAND YEARS. The only living witness says she could be wrong.
detail:
NARROWED, NOT CLOSED, AND THE NARROWING CAME WITH ITS OWN DISCLAIMER ATTACHED.

VIRAENA: I DON’T KNOW ABOUT THE IF WE CAN, WE HAVEN’T TRIED SINCE, BUT I WANT TO SAY NO THAT WAS TIED TO OUR ABILITY TO GET PREGNANT, BUT I COULD BE WRONG.

SO THE ARCHIVE NOW HOLDS ONE FACT, ONE LEAN, AND ONE DISCLAIMER, AND IT IS KEEPING ALL THREE SEPARATE.
THE FACT: THEY HAVE NOT TRIED SINCE. One conferral in thirty-two centuries and no second attempt.
THE LEAN: IT WAS TIED TO THE FERTILITY, which they had deliberately removed after Vienna. If that is right, THE GIFT WENT OUT WITH IT.
THE DISCLAIMER: SHE COULD BE WRONG, offered unprompted by the only living witness.

WHICH ANSWERS ONE OF THE FIVE SUB-QUESTIONS AND LEAVES THE REST. WHETHER THEY STILL CAN: PROBABLY NOT, BELIEVED, UNTESTED. WHETHER IT IS SELENE’S OR SHARED: still open, and the fertility link now cuts toward SHARED, since both of them had the procedure. WHAT IT COSTS: still unknown. WHETHER IT IS THE SAME THING NEREID DOES: still unknown. WHETHER ANYONE SINCE: no.

AND THE TIMELINE FITS, WHICH IS WORTH NOTING BECAUSE IT DID NOT HAVE TO. THE CONFERRAL WAS THE VIKING AGE. THE REMOVAL WAS AFTER VIENNA, around the 11th century. THE GIFT WAS GIVEN WHILE THEY STILL HAD IT TO GIVE, and on this reading the window shut at the same table where the day-counting stopped.

THE ARCHIVE IS STILL NOT REASONING FORWARD FROM THIS, AND NOW HAS A SECOND REASON NOT TO. The first was that there is nobody at Ghost Haven to confer it on. THE SECOND IS THAT THE OBVIOUS NEXT QUESTION IS WHETHER THEY GAVE UP THE GIFT KNOWINGLY WHEN THEY HAD THE FERTILITY REMOVED, AND THAT QUESTION IS HERS TO RAISE, NOT THE RECORD’S. See c-gift-tied.
